observations: Photo 0 shows a white multifunction printer wrapped in plastic.
The front panel has a paper output tray and a control panel with buttons.
The top lid is open, revealing a document or manual inside.
The printer appears to be new or unused, as it is still in protective wrapping.
There is a watermark 'ALCHANDO TOOLS' across the image.

claims.claim: Increase productivity with a colour MFP
claims.evidence: No performance data or productivity metrics are visible in the photo. The claim is subjective and cannot be verified remotely.

claims.claim: Get the fastest in-class two-sided printing speed
claims.evidence: No speed specifications or testing are visible. This is a performance claim that cannot be confirmed from a single photo.

claims.claim: Low page count, under 20,000 copies. New drum and toner just fitted, no paper jam.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The printer may be non-functional or have internal damage not visible in the photo.
risks.proof: A video showing the printer powering on, printing a test page, and operating two-sided printing.

risks.risk: The printer may be a refurbished or used unit despite the wrapping.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the serial number and model label, along with a photo of the interior and power cord.
risks.if_unproven: priced as used, with lower value

risks.risk: The printer may be missing essential accessories (e.g., toner, cables, power adapter).
risks.proof: A photo showing all included accessories laid out next to the printer.

proof_requests: Close-up of the sticker with the model number, usually inside the original packaging.
A clear photo of the model label or serial number on the printer.
A video showing the printer powering on and printing a test page.
A photo of the interior and power cord to verify condition.
A photo of all included accessories.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
